definitions.ambiguity: evidence text found in >1 section resolves to the earliest one
definitions.paragraph: distinct mapped evidence paragraph (a heading-evidence string counts as one location)
definitions.primary_denominator: answers that are answerable (extractive/abstractive/yes-no), have non-empty evidence, contain no FLOAT SELECTED item, and whose every text evidence string maps to the paper (exact paragraph, whitespace-normalised paragraph, or section heading)
definitions.section_full_path: full_text section_name as given, e.g. 'Experiments ::: Setup'
definitions.unit: answer (annotation); a question can have several

groups_note: 'pooled' = train+dev (the primary pool); 'pooled_with_test' adds the public test split, which carries most of the multi-annotator questions
label: EXPLORATORY, descriptive, not pre-registered

reproduction_55_5.paper_claim: Among the answerable questions with text-only evidence, 55.5% of the answers have multi-paragraph evidence (Dasigi et al. 2021, sec. 3); computed over all 5,049 questions of the release the paper describes
